name: Deepgram
desc: Deepgram is an AI-powered speech recognition platform that provides real-time transcription, text-to-speech, and audio analysis capabilities.

actions.name: transcribe_audio
actions.description: Transcribes an audio or video file or URL and returns the transcript, with optional speakers, paragraphs, summary, topics and more.

actions.name: analyze_text
actions.description: Summarizes English text and detects its topics, intents and sentiment.

actions.name: create_summary
actions.description: Produces a summary of the content from an English audio file.

actions.name: create_transcription_callback
actions.description: Starts a transcription and has Deepgram send the result to a callback URL. To receive it in another flow, use the Catch Webhook URL of the Webhook piece.

actions.name: text_to_speech
actions.description: Converts text (up to 2,000 characters) to an audio file.

actions.name: list_models
actions.description: Lists Deepgram speech-to-text models and text-to-speech voices, one row per model.

actions.name: list_projects
actions.description: Lists the Deepgram projects this API key can access.

actions.name: get_project
actions.description: Gets the name and settings of a Deepgram project.

actions.name: update_project
actions.description: Changes the name of a Deepgram project.

actions.name: list_project_members
actions.description: Lists the members of a Deepgram project with their roles. Needs an admin or owner API key.

actions.name: list_project_keys
actions.description: Lists the API keys of a Deepgram project (never the secret values). A member key only sees its own keys.

actions.name: list_requests
actions.description: Lists past API requests of a Deepgram project with status, duration and cost.

actions.name: get_request
actions.description: Gets one past Deepgram request by ID with its status, duration and cost.

actions.name: get_usage
actions.description: Gets audio hours, requests, characters and tokens used by a Deepgram project, optionally grouped.

actions.name: get_balances
actions.description: Gets the remaining prepaid credit of a Deepgram project. Needs an admin or owner API key.

actions.name: get_billing_breakdown
actions.description: Gets what a Deepgram project spent in dollars for a date range, optionally grouped. Needs an admin or owner API key.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
